verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, make Jerusalem aware of her disgusting practices.
Say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says to Jerusalem: Your roots and your birth were in the land of the Canaanites. Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
On the day you were born, no one cut your umbilical cord or washed you with water to make you clean. No one rubbed you with salt or wrapped you in cloths.
No one looked on you with pity or cared enough to do any of these things for you. Instead, you were thrown out into an open field, because you were hated on the day you were born.
Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood. As you lay there in your blood, I said to you, "Live!" Yes, as you lay there in your blood, I said to you, "Live!"
I made you grow like a plant in the field. You grew up and became tall and very beautiful. Your breasts developed and your hair grew, but you were still naked and bare.

Later I passed by again and looked at you, and I saw that you were old enough for love. So I spread the corner of my cloak over you and covered your nakedness. I made a promise to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord GOD, and you became mine.
I bathed you with water, washed the blood off you, and rubbed you with oil.
I dressed you in embroidered clothes and put fine leather sandals on your feet. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
I gave you jewelry. I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck.
I put a ring in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

So you were decorated with gold and silver. Your clothes were made of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate the finest flour, honey, and olive oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.
Your fame spread among the nations because of your beauty. It was perfect because of the splendor I had given you, says the Lord GOD.
But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You offered yourself to anyone who passed by, and your beauty became theirs.
You took some of your clothes and made colorful shrines at the high places, and there you acted like a prostitute. Such things should never happen.
You also took the beautiful jewelry made of my gold and silver, which I had given you, and made male idols for yourself and worshiped them like a prostitute.
You took your embroidered clothes to dress them, and you offered my oil and incense to them.
You also offered them the food I gave you, the fine flour, olive oil, and honey I fed you with, as a sweet-smelling offering. That is what happened, says the Lord GOD.
You even took your sons and daughters, the children you bore to me, and sacrificed them as food for the idols. Wasn't your prostitution enough?
You slaughtered my children and offered them up to the idols in the fire.
In all your disgusting practices and your prostitution, you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
How terrible, how terrible it will be for you, says the Lord GOD. After all your other wickedness,
you built yourself a shrine and set up a high platform in every town square.
At the head of every street you built your high platform and turned your beauty into something disgusting. You offered your body to everyone who passed by, and you kept adding to your prostitution.
You prostituted yourself with your neighbors the Egyptians, with their lustful desires, and you made me angry with your many acts of prostitution.
So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory. I handed you over to your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your shameful behavior.
You also prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, because you could never be satisfied. Even after that, you were still not satisfied.
Then you added to your prostitution with Babylonia, the land of merchants, but even this did not satisfy you.
How weak-willed you are, says the Lord GOD, to do all these things, acting like a shameless prostitute!
You built your shrines at the head of every street and set up your high platforms in every town square. But you were not like a prostitute, because you refused payment.
You are an unfaithful wife who prefers strangers to her own husband!
Every prostitute is paid, but you give gifts to all your lovers. You bribe them to come to you from everywhere for your prostitution.
So you are the opposite of other women in your prostitution. No one comes after you. You pay instead of being paid. You are the opposite!'
So, you prostitute, listen to the LORD's message!

This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your prostitution with your lovers and with all your disgusting idols, and because you gave them your children's blood,

I am going to gather all your lovers, the ones you enjoyed, both those you loved and those you hated. I will gather them against you from every side and strip you naked in front of them, so that they will see you completely naked.
I will sentence you to the punishment for women who commit adultery and murder. I will bring on you the bloody punishment of my fury and jealous anger.
I will hand you over to your lovers, and they will tear down your shrines and destroy your high platforms. They will strip off your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
They will bring a mob against you. They will stone you and cut you to pieces with their swords.
They will burn down your houses and punish you while many women watch. I will put an end to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
Then my fury against you will calm down, and my jealous anger will turn away from you. I will be calm and no longer angry.

Because you did not remember the days of your youth but made me furious with all these things, I will bring down on your head what you have done, says the Lord GOD. Did you not add sexual sin to all your other disgusting practices?
Everyone who uses sayings will use this one about you: "Like mother, like daughter."

You are truly your mother's daughter. She hated her husband and her children. And you are truly your sisters' sister. They hated their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
Your older sister was Samaria, who lived north of you with her daughters. Your younger sister was Sodom, who lived south of you with her daughters.
You not only followed their ways and copied their disgusting practices, but in a very short time you became even more wicked than they were in everything you did.
As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.
This was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were proud, overfed, and lived at ease without a care. But they did not help the poor and needy.
They were arrogant and did disgusting things in front of me. So I got rid of them, as you have seen.
Samaria did not commit even half the sins you did. You have done far more disgusting things than they did, and you have made your sisters look righteous by comparison.

Now you must bear your disgrace, because you have made your sisters look better. Your sins were more disgusting than theirs, so they seem more righteous than you. So be ashamed and bear your disgrace, because you have made your sisters look righteous.
But I will bring them back from captivity, Sodom and her daughters, and Samaria and her daughters, and I will bring you back from captivity along with them.
Then you will bear your disgrace and be ashamed of everything you have done, which made them feel comforted.
Your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will be restored to what they were before. And you and your daughters will also be restored to what you were before.
In the days of your pride, you would not even mention your sister Sodom,

before your own wickedness was exposed. Now you have become the object of scorn for the daughters of Aram and all her neighbors, and for the daughters of the Philistines. All those around you look down on you.
You must bear the consequences of your sexual sin and your disgusting practices, says the LORD.
This is what the Lord GOD says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have treated your promise with contempt by breaking the covenant.
But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will make a covenant with you that will last forever.
Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you welcome your sisters, both older and younger. I will give them to you as daughters, though not because of my covenant with you.
I will make my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
Then, when I forgive you for everything you have done, you will remember and be ashamed. You will never again open your mouth because of your disgrace, says the Lord GOD.'"
